parameters.name: Href
parameters.doc: When set, renders as an anchor tag instead of a button.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.doc: Tooltip text shown on hover.

parameters.name: Dense
parameters.doc: Compact (dense) mode with reduced padding.

events.name: CheckedChanged
events.doc: Callback when checkbox state changes.

events.name: OnClick
events.doc: Click handler. The dropdown closes after this fires (when CloseOnSelect is true).

parameters.name: Text
parameters.doc: Submenu trigger label.

parameters.name: Icon
parameters.doc: Optional leading icon (raw SVG markup).

parameters.name: IconColor
parameters.doc: Optional icon color.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.doc: Whether the submenu is disabled.

parameters.name: ChildContent
parameters.doc: Submenu items.

parameters.name: CssClass
parameters.doc: Additional CSS class on the submenu item.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.doc: Title text shown in the modal header.

parameters.name: ChildContent
parameters.doc: Body content rendered inside the modal.

parameters.name: FooterContent
parameters.doc: Optional footer content (buttons, etc.).

parameters.name: HeaderContent
parameters.doc: Custom header content — replaces the default title+icon layout.

parameters.name: Icon
parameters.doc: SVG path data or icon name for the title icon.

parameters.name: CloseIcon
parameters.doc: Custom SVG path data for the close button icon.

parameters.name: ShowClose
parameters.doc: Whether to show the close (X) button in the header. Default: true.

parameters.name: CloseOnBackdrop
parameters.doc: Whether clicking the backdrop closes the modal. Default: true.

parameters.name: CloseOnEscape
parameters.doc: Whether pressing Escape closes the modal. Default: true.

parameters.name: Animation
parameters.doc: The open/close animation type. Default: Scale.

parameters.name: Draggable
parameters.doc: Whether the modal can be dragged by its header.

parameters.name: AutoFocus
parameters.doc: Whether to auto-focus the first focusable element inside the modal. Default: true.

parameters.name: TrapFocus
parameters.doc: Whether to trap focus inside the modal. Default: true.

parameters.name: ScrollLock
parameters.doc: Whether to lock body scroll when the modal is open. Default: true.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.doc: Custom CSS width (e.g. "600px", "50vw").

parameters.name: MaxWidth
parameters.doc: Custom CSS max-width.

parameters.name: MinWidth
parameters.doc: Custom CSS min-width.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.doc: Preset size (Sm/Md/Lg/Xl). Default: Md.

parameters.name: FullScreen
parameters.doc: Whether the modal fills the entire screen. Overrides Size.

parameters.name: Position
parameters.doc: Vertical position on screen: Center, Top, or Bottom. Default: Center.

parameters.name: BackdropContent
parameters.doc: Content rendered inside the backdrop layer.

parameters.name: BackdropDismiss
parameters.doc: Whether backdrop dismiss is allowed. Default: true.

parameters.name: BackdropBlur
parameters.doc: CSS blur value applied to the backdrop (e.g. "8px").

parameters.name: ShowMinimize
parameters.doc: Whether to show the minimize button in the header.

parameters.name: ShowMaximize
parameters.doc: Whether to show the maximize/restore button in the header.

parameters.name: Resizable
parameters.doc: Whether the modal can be resized by dragging edges/corners.

parameters.name: ResponsiveMode
parameters.doc: Whether to auto-switch to fullscreen on narrow viewports (<= 768px).

parameters.name: Loading
parameters.doc: Whether to show a loading overlay inside the modal.

parameters.name: LoadingContent
parameters.doc: Custom loading overlay content.

parameters.name: BodyClass
parameters.doc: Additional CSS class for the modal body.

parameters.name: HeaderClass
parameters.doc: Additional CSS class for the modal header.

parameters.name: FooterClass
parameters.doc: Additional CSS class for the modal footer.

parameters.name: NoPadding
parameters.doc: Removes body padding for edge-to-edge content.

parameters.name: Glass
parameters.doc: Enables glassmorphism effect (semi-transparent background with blur).

parameters.name: CustomZIndex
parameters.doc: Custom z-index value. Overrides the default modal z-index stack.

parameters.name: ShortcutSubmit
parameters.doc: Keyboard shortcut to submit (e.g. "ctrl+enter"). Triggers OnSubmit.

events.name: OnSubmit
events.doc: Fired when the shortcut key combination is pressed.

events.name: OnClose
events.doc: Fired after the modal has fully closed.

events.name: OnClosing
events.doc: Fired while the modal is closing (before animation completes).

events.name: OnOpened
events.doc: Fired after the modal has fully opened and animation completed.

events.name: OnMaximizedChanged
events.doc: Fired when the maximized state changes. Receives the new maximized value.

events.name: OnMinimized
events.doc: Fired when the minimize button is clicked.

parameters.name: Open
parameters.doc: Gets or sets whether the popover is currently open.

parameters.name: Placement
parameters.doc: Gets or sets the placement of the popover relative to the trigger. Default is <see cref="SgPlacement.BottomStart"/>.

parameters.name: Role
parameters.doc: Gets or sets the ARIA role attribute for the popover. Default is "dialog".

parameters.name: Title
parameters.doc: Gets or sets the title text displayed in the popover header.

parameters.name: ShowArrow
parameters.doc: Gets or sets whether to display an arrow pointing to the trigger element.

parameters.name: CloseOnOutsideClick
parameters.doc: Gets or sets whether the popover closes when clicking outside of it. Default is true.

parameters.name: CloseOnEscape
parameters.doc: Gets or sets whether the popover closes when pressing the Escape key. Default is true.

parameters.name: Trigger
parameters.doc: Gets or sets the trigger behavior for the popover. Default is <see cref="SgTrigger.Click"/>. When <see cref="SgTrigger.Manual"/>, use <see cref="OpenAsync"/>/<see cref="CloseAsync"/> or the <see cref="Open"/> parameter.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.doc: Gets or sets whether the popover is disabled.

parameters.name: ButtonText
parameters.doc: Gets or sets the text for the default trigger button. Default is "Open".

parameters.name: ButtonVariant
parameters.doc: Gets or sets the variant for the default trigger button. Default is <see cref="SgButtonVariant.Default"/>.

parameters.name: ButtonSize
parameters.doc: Gets or sets the size for the default trigger button. Default is <see cref="SgSize.Md"/>.

parameters.name: TriggerContent
parameters.doc: Gets or sets the custom trigger content. When provided, replaces the default button trigger.

parameters.name: ChildContent
parameters.doc: Gets or sets the content to display inside the popover. Required.

parameters.name: UsePortal
parameters.doc: Gets or sets whether to use a Portal to render the popover content. Recommended to stay true to avoid overflow clipping and stacking context issues.

parameters.name: PortalTarget
parameters.doc: Gets or sets the target element selector where the popover should be rendered via Portal. Default is "body". Set to null to render in-place (not recommended for nested overlays).

parameters.name: ZIndex
parameters.doc: Gets or sets a fixed z-index for the popover. If not provided, it will be automatically allocated from <see cref="SgZIndexService.PopoverBase"/>.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.doc: Gets or sets the popover size. When null, uses the default size.

parameters.name: MaxWidth
parameters.doc: Gets or sets the maximum width of the popover. Example: "360px", "50vw".

parameters.name: Color
parameters.doc: Gets or sets a custom CSS color value for the popover background. Example: "var(--sg-color-info)", "#3b82f6", etc.

parameters.name: Interactive
parameters.doc: Gets or sets whether the popover content is interactive. When true and <see cref="Trigger"/> is <see cref="SgTrigger.Hover"/>, the popover stays open when the mouse moves over the popover itself, allowing interaction with rich content.

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.doc: Gets or sets the offset distance in pixels between the popover and the trigger element. Default is 6.

events.name: OpenChanged
events.doc: Gets or sets the callback invoked when the open state changes.

parameters.name: ChildContent
parameters.doc: Content to teleport to the target container.

parameters.name: Visible
parameters.doc: When <c>true</c>, teleports content to the render target. Supports two-way binding.

parameters.name: ZIndex
parameters.doc: Explicit z-index for the portal. When omitted, auto-allocates from <see cref="SgZIndexService.PortalBase"/>. Set to 0 to suppress any z-index.

parameters.name: PreventScroll
parameters.doc: When <c>true</c>, locks body scroll while the portal is open.

parameters.name: AutoFocus
parameters.doc: When <c>true</c>, focuses the first focusable element inside the portal on open.

parameters.name: RenderAt
parameters.doc: CSS selector for the target container. Defaults to <c>body</c>.

parameters.name: TransitionDuration
parameters.doc: Transition/animation duration in milliseconds.

events.name: VisibleChanged
events.doc: Fires when <see cref="Visible"/> changes.

events.name: OnTeleported
events.doc: Fired after the portal content has been teleported to the target container.

parameters.name: ChildContent
parameters.doc: Content rendered by the portal host. Typically empty — reserved for future use.

parameters.name: Text
parameters.doc: Gets or sets the tooltip text to display. Required when <see cref="RichContent"/> is not set.

parameters.name: ChildContent
parameters.doc: Gets or sets the content that triggers the tooltip.

parameters.name: Placement
parameters.doc: Gets or sets the preferred placement. Default is <see cref="SgPlacement.Top"/>.

parameters.name: Trigger
parameters.doc: Gets or sets the trigger behavior. Default is <see cref="SgTrigger.Hover"/>.

parameters.name: OpenDelay
parameters.doc: Gets or sets the delay in milliseconds before showing the tooltip. Default 0.

parameters.name: CloseDelay
parameters.doc: Gets or sets the delay in milliseconds before hiding the tooltip. Default 0.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.doc: Gets or sets whether the tooltip is disabled.

parameters.name: RichContent
parameters.doc: Gets or sets rich content displayed inside the tooltip. When set, overrides <see cref="Text"/>.

parameters.name: ShowArrow
parameters.doc: Gets or sets whether to show an arrow pointing to the trigger element.

parameters.name: Color
parameters.doc: Gets or sets a custom CSS color value for the tooltip background. Example: "var(--sg-color-info)", "#3b82f6", etc.

parameters.name: MaxWidth
parameters.doc: Gets or sets the maximum width of the tooltip. Example: "280px", "50vw".

parameters.name: Size
parameters.doc: Gets or sets the tooltip size. When null, uses the default size.

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.doc: Gets or sets the offset distance in pixels between the tooltip and the trigger element. Default is 8.

parameters.name: FollowCursor
parameters.doc: Gets or sets whether the tooltip follows the mouse cursor. Default is false. When enabled, the tooltip repositions on mouse move within the trigger element.

parameters.name: Interactive
parameters.doc: Gets or sets whether the tooltip content is interactive. When true, the tooltip does not hide when the mouse moves over the tooltip itself, allowing interaction with rich content.

parameters.name: Config
parameters.doc: Gets or sets the LangGraph configuration.

parameters.name: OnNodeExecute
parameters.doc: Callback invoked when a node executes. Receives the node ID and current state.

events.name: OnStep
events.doc: Callback invoked on each execution step.

events.name: OnError
events.doc: Callback invoked when an error occurs.

events.name: OnInitialized
events.doc: Callback invoked when the provider is initialized.

events.name: OnInterrupt
events.doc: Callback invoked when execution is interrupted.
